newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MINISTRY DRAWING UP PORT PRIVATISATION PLAN.
newsitem.headline: MINISTRY DRAWING UP PORT PRIVATISATION PLAN.

text.p: Lithuania's transport ministry plans to draw up a privatisation plan in the near future for strategic companies in the port of Klaipeda, the daily Lietuvos rytas reported on Monday.

The newspaper said that the ministry will use a 290,000 ECU grant from the PHARE programme to prepare a strategy for selling off the Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company, Klaipeda Stevedoring and other key port assets.
"In any way, we will have to privatise the port companies 100 percent," the paper quoted Transport Minister Algis Zhvaliauskas as saying.
The paper said that in the first stage, the ministry aims to create a favourable climate for investors by privatising 51 percent of the share capital in the port enterprises.
